checks: SELECT count(*) AS violations FROM "pg_temp"."edge" weft_guard_edge LEFT JOIN "pg_temp"."object" weft_guard_from ON weft_guard_from.id=weft_guard_edge."source_id" AND weft_guard_from.type_id=weft_guard_edge."source_type" LEFT JOIN "pg_temp"."object" weft_guard_to ON weft_guard_to.id=weft_guard_edge."target_id" AND weft_guard_to.type_id=weft_guard_edge."target_type" WHERE weft_guard_edge."rel_type_id"=$1::pg_catalog.int4 AND (weft_guard_edge."source_type" IS DISTINCT FROM $2::pg_catalog.int4 OR weft_guard_edge."target_type" IS DISTINCT FROM $3::pg_catalog.int4 OR weft_guard_from.id IS NULL OR weft_guard_to.id IS NULL)

SELECT count(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT weft_guard_from.id FROM "pg_temp"."object" weft_guard_from LEFT JOIN "pg_temp"."edge" weft_guard_edge ON weft_guard_edge."source_id"=weft_guard_from.id AND weft_guard_edge."source_type"=weft_guard_from.type_id AND weft_guard_edge."rel_type_id"=$1::pg_catalog.int4 AND weft_guard_edge."target_type"=$3::pg_catalog.int4 WHERE weft_guard_from.type_id=$2::pg_catalog.int4 GROUP BY weft_guard_from.id,weft_guard_from.type_id HAVING pg_catalog.count(weft_guard_edge."source_id") < $4::pg_catalog.numeric OR pg_catalog.count(weft_guard_edge."source_id") > $5::pg_catalog.numeric) AS weft_guard_cardinality

SELECT count(*) AS violations FROM "pg_temp"."edge" weft_guard_edge LEFT JOIN "pg_temp"."object" weft_guard_from ON weft_guard_from.id=weft_guard_edge."target_id" AND weft_guard_from.type_id=weft_guard_edge."target_type" LEFT JOIN "pg_temp"."object" weft_guard_to ON weft_guard_to.id=weft_guard_edge."source_id" AND weft_guard_to.type_id=weft_guard_edge."source_type" WHERE weft_guard_edge."rel_type_id"=$1::pg_catalog.int4 AND (weft_guard_edge."target_type" IS DISTINCT FROM $2::pg_catalog.int4 OR weft_guard_edge."source_type" IS DISTINCT FROM $3::pg_catalog.int4 OR weft_guard_from.id IS NULL OR weft_guard_to.id IS NULL)

SELECT count(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT weft_guard_from.id FROM "pg_temp"."object" weft_guard_from LEFT JOIN "pg_temp"."edge" weft_guard_edge ON weft_guard_edge."target_id"=weft_guard_from.id AND weft_guard_edge."target_type"=weft_guard_from.type_id AND weft_guard_edge."rel_type_id"=$1::pg_catalog.int4 AND weft_guard_edge."source_type"=$3::pg_catalog.int4 WHERE weft_guard_from.type_id=$2::pg_catalog.int4 GROUP BY weft_guard_from.id,weft_guard_from.type_id HAVING pg_catalog.count(weft_guard_edge."target_id") < $4::pg_catalog.numeric OR pg_catalog.count(weft_guard_edge."target_id") > $5::pg_catalog.numeric) AS weft_guard_cardinality
